title: Decomposing Determinantal Varieties from Statistics via Matroid Theory
summary: We study determinantal varieties from conditional independence models with hidden variables, focusing on their irreducible decompositions, dimensions, degrees, and Gröbner bases. Each variety encodes a collection of matroids, whose flats capture algebraic dependencies among variables. Using this approach, we provide a systematic description of the components, their dimensions, and defining equations, and introduce a combinatorial framework for computing the degree of the determinantal variety.
